The margin is thin and shrinks with every spec declaration (#25657 read `main` about 580 MB lower two days ago). A required lane that keeps going red gets fixed (maintainer: 「平台测试清单反复变红，肯定要修啊」).

The dev picks between the one-line flag and extending the root config. Then sweep the other workspace tsconfigs that also extend nothing, and report which lib-check-only errors (if any) the flag would hide.
- ⛔ No raised heap limit in place of the fix: that only moves the cliff.
